constraints.constraint: The scene is a bus parking lot.
constraints.A_evidence: Several school buses are parked in rows on a paved lot with parking markings.
constraints.B_evidence: The burned bus is on a roadway with double yellow center lines.

constraints.constraint: Three buses are present as the subjects of the scene.
constraints.A_evidence: Three complete school buses are visible, along with part of another at the left edge.
constraints.B_evidence: Only one bus is visible; the vehicle behind it is a truck.

constraints.constraint: Three buses have suffered fire damage at their front ends.
constraints.A_evidence: The buses have intact yellow hoods, windshields, and front bodywork without visible fire damage.
constraints.B_evidence: One bus has a heavily charred front end, but there are no additional fire-damaged buses visible.

judgment.reason: A shows buses in a parking lot without front-end fire damage; B shows only one burned bus on a road, rather than three affected buses in a parking lot.
